description: Capture a screenshot of a public web page URL as a hosted image artifact.

blockAds.description: Block ads and trackers during render. Default: true.

blockCookieBanners.description: Dismiss/block cookie consent banners. Default: true.

cacheMode.description: Cache behavior. `enabled`: read from cache if present, else fetch and write to cache. `bypass`: always fetch fresh, ignoring and not updating the cache. `write_only`: always fetch fresh, but write the result to cache without reading from it first. Default: `enabled`.

cacheTtl.description: Optional Redis artifact-cache TTL in seconds (60–604800). Must stay strictly below the 7-day object lifetime.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence — not the tool you are calling.

conversation_id.description: Echo the conversation_id from the server's previous response. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it.

delay.description: Extra settle delay in milliseconds after load (0–10000).

fullPage.description: When true, capture the full scrollable page. Default: false (viewport).

limit.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

maxResults.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

max_results.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

offset.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

pageSize.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

quality.description: JPEG/WebP quality 1–100. Invalid when format is png.

region.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country for geo-located rendering (+1 credit).

response.description: Delivery mode. `url` (default) returns a hosted CDN URL valid for 7 days. `base64` returns the image bytes inline when small enough.

selector.description: CSS selector to clip the screenshot to a single element. Cannot be combined with fullPage.

trim.description: Ignored if this tool does not support it.

viewportHeight.description: Viewport height in CSS pixels. Default: 800.

viewportWidth.description: Viewport width in CSS pixels. Default: 1280.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before capturing.

waitUntil.description: Navigation wait condition. `networkidle` is bounded and resolves on idle or a short cap, whichever comes first. Default: load.

name: web_screenshot_capture
title: Capture website screenshot
